Package io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile
Static compilation of Python function bodies: the mode and options, the decisions taken for every candidate function and the report that explains them.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

    EventLoopSafety
    Which compiled bodies never enter Python, so that a route whose body is one runs on the event loop as a Java route does.
    Ir
    The typed intermediate representation of a compiled function body: what the Python side lowers a body into, and what the Java side turns into SourceGen statements.
    Ir.And
    A short-circuit conjunction of booleans.
    Ir.Assign
    The assignment of a new value to a declared local.
    Ir.Binary
    A binary operation on numbers or strings.
    Ir.Body
    A sequence of statements.
    Ir.Break
    A break out of a loop.
    Ir.Cast
    A conversion between Java types: a widening or narrowing of numbers, or a cast of references.
    Ir.Catch
    A handler of a try statement.
    Ir.Compare
    A comparison, of type boolean.
    Ir.CompiledBody
    A compiled function body with the Java signature it is generated into.
    Ir.Conditional
    A conditional expression whose branches share a type.
    Ir.Const
    A literal.
    Ir.Continue
    A continue of a loop.
    Ir.Eval
    An expression evaluated for its effect.

    Ir.Expression
    An expression, which has a type.
    Ir.Field
    A read of an instance field.

    A loop over a range of longs, as Python's for x in range(start, stop, step).

    A conditional statement.
    Ir.InvokeJava
    A call of a Java method with a chosen overload.
    Ir.InvokePython
    A call of a method of a Python object of the compilation through the Python object itself: the generated class of the receiver declares no Java method for it (a method the class does not bridge, a call relying on default arguments), so the method is invoked as Python code would.
    Ir.InvokeSibling
    A call of a method of the class on self.
    Ir.Local
    The declaration of a local with its first value.
    Ir.LocalRef
    A declared local.
    Ir.ModuleAttribute
    A read of an injected attribute of a module: a bean the module's generated class holds in a field of its instance, set when the bean is injected.
    Ir.NewJava
    A construction of a Java object with a chosen constructor.
    Ir.NewPythonException
    An exception of a Python exception class of the compilation, created as Python creates it: the Python class called with the arguments, the Python exception wrapped in the generated Java class through its Value constructor, as the runtime wraps a Python exception that reaches Java code.
    Ir.Or
    A short-circuit disjunction of booleans.
    Ir.Param
    A parameter of the compiled method.

    What may make a compiled body enter Python, as the planner finds it: what in the body does by itself, the compiled functions of the compilation it calls through Java, and the generated classes it constructs and the accessors of introspected ones it calls, which enter Python unless their generated constructor only assigns Java fields and the accessor only touches its field.
    Ir.PythonMember
    A read of an attribute of a Python object of the compilation through the Python object: an attribute the generated class of the receiver declares no accessor for.
    Ir.Return

    Ir.SelfProperty
    A property of self.
    Ir.Statement
    A statement.
    Ir.StaticField

    Ir.StrJoin

    Ir.Throw
    A throw of a Java exception.

    The Python truthiness of a value, of type boolean.
    Ir.Try
    A try statement with typed catches.
    Ir.Unary
    A unary operation.

    StaticBodyGenerator
    Turns the Ir of a compiled body into SourceGen statements inside a stub method.
    StaticBodyGenerator.SelfAccess
    How a compiled body reaches the properties of self: a Java field of the stub, or the member of the Python object behind it.
    StaticCompilationConfiguration
    The static compilation requested for a compilation: the mode, where the report goes, whether an explicit switch that cannot be honoured fails the build, and the decorator names accepted as the switch.
    StaticCompilationDecision
    The decision taken for one candidate function: whether its body is compiled to Java, how the decision to attempt it was reached, and every reason it was not compiled.
    StaticCompilationDecision.Outcome
    What became of a candidate function.
    StaticCompilationDecision.Reason
    Why a body is not compiled.
    StaticCompilationDecision.Scope
    The declaration that decided whether compilation was attempted: the nearest CompileStatic switch, or the compilation's mode when there is none.
    StaticCompilationDecision.Stats
    What a body contains, for the report.
    StaticCompilationHints
    What an author can change so that a function the planner refused is compiled: one suggestion per reason rule, sharpened by the message of the reason where one rule covers several situations.
    StaticCompilationMode
    How much of a compilation's Python code is compiled to Java in the generated stubs.
    StaticCompilationPlan
    What the planner decided for a compilation: one decision per function, the bodies it lowered, and the diagnostics for the explicit switches it could not honour.
    StaticCompilationReport
    Writes the decisions of a compilation as decisions.jsonl (one JSON object per line, the first one describing the plan, the input of the page a build tool renders) and summary.txt (the decisions grouped by outcome with totals per outcome and per reason), every reason carrying a hint of what to change, and keeps them as decisions.properties, the state an incremental build reads back to complete its own decisions with those of the sources it did not plan.
    StaticDelegation
    Whether the Python callers of a compiled method may run its Java body, and how the rewritten Python method guards the call (see apply_delegation).
    StaticLineMap
    The Python positions of the Java a stub with compiled bodies is compiled to, so that a stack trace or a debugger shows the Python file and line of a compiled statement rather than the generated Java.
